name: generapp
description: Create small shared web apps (shopping lists, chore planners, budgets, group games) and publish them at a link that friends or family open on their phones.

capabilities: Create and publish small web apps at a shareable link
Update the files of your existing apps
Browse the public app library and copy an app to adapt it
defaultPrompt: Create a shared shopping list app for my flatmates, showing who added each item.
Show my GenerApp apps and the limits of my account.
Find an app in the GenerApp library to keep score in board games and copy it for me.

positive.description: List the user's apps and account limits
positive.prompt: Show me my GenerApp apps and the limits of my account.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the apps of the demo account (name, public link, version) and the plan with its limits (apps, file sizes, daily tool calls).

positive.description: Create and publish a new app
positive.prompt: Create a GenerApp app "SharedCart" : a shared shopping list for flatmates, where we can tick items and see who added them.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the app, writes app.json, index.html and icon.svg, validates it, publishes it and returns a public link. The link opens a working shopping list on desktop and mobile; items added on one device appear on the other.

positive.prompt: In my GenerApp app "SharedCart", add a button at the top that switches between a light and a dark theme, then publish it again.
positive.tools_triggered: list_apps, list_files, read_file, write_file, validate_app, deploy_app
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the current files, rewrites the app's files with the new button, validates and republishes. The same public link now shows the button, and tapping it switches the theme.

positive.description: Delete a file from an app
positive.prompt: In my GenerApp app "SharedCart", delete the file notes.txt, then publish the app again.
positive.expected_behavior: Deletes notes.txt from the app's working copy, publishes, and confirms that the file is no longer part of the published app. The app keeps working.

positive.description: Find and copy an app from the library
positive.prompt: Find an app in the GenerApp library to keep score in board games and copy it to my account.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists matching library apps, copies one into the account as a new draft app and returns its app_id and the next steps to adapt and publish it.

negative.description: General question unrelated to building an app
negative.prompt: What is the capital of Australia?

negative.description: Code for the user's own computer, not a hosted app
negative.prompt: Write a Python script that renames all the photos in a folder on my laptop by date.

negative.description: Explanation request that needs no tool
negative.prompt: Explain the difference between a website and a mobile app.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: create, update, validate and publish GenerApp apps, and copy apps from the public library.
